packages/appearance/platinum/src/styles/.reason: Platinum's scroll-bar arrow glyph geometry: the half, 1.5x and 2x of the arrow stripe unit (--window-scrollbar-arrow-size) are pixel positions in the glyph art, not theme proportions (Part G, kept on purpose).
Pixel-grid multiples of the one bevel knob (--control-strip-bevel-width x 2, x 3, x 4) inside classicy-px-rect: coordinates on the Control Strip art's bevel-pixel grid, not theme proportions (H-R7).

packages/appearance/system7/src/styles/_.reason: System 7's pixel-grid art: the pressed close and zoom boxes' starburst, the windoid close box's cross, the menu bar's screen corners, the menu checkmark, the menu and pop-up triangles and the push buttons' rounded corners and default ring are one-pixel rectangles placed in multiples of the one grid knob (--window-box-pixel x n, one site in the px() helper), coordinates in the art, not theme proportions (H-R7, as the Control Strip's).

src/SystemFolder/HyperCard/HyperCard.scs.reason: Handle-centering halves: an editor selection handle is pulled half its own size (--hyper-card-handle-size / -2) over the corner or edge it marks; geometry, not a role (H-R7).
Edge midpoints: a side handle sits at 50% minus half its own size (--hyper-card-handle-size / 2), centered on the edge it marks; geometry, not a role (H-R21).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/Button/.reason: The button spacing scale: the Sm/Md/Lg/Xl padding and margin classes scale --control-padding and --window-padding-size by the named Sass map $classicy-button-spacing (0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), so the scale is named in Sass and still follows the Metrics tab (H 6.2a, H-R29a).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/ColorPi.reason: Crayon-art geometry: each crayon row slides up by all but its tip, (1 - $cp-crayon-tip) of a crayon's height, where 0.31 is the tip's share of the 36 x 96 crayon SVG; a proportion of the artwork over the component's own --cp-crayon-cols and --cp-crayon-aspect, not a theme metric (H-R7).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/Desktop.reason: The alias badge is a quarter of the icon (--desktop-icon-size / 4, measured off Mac OS 8), not the grid padding --desktop-icon-padding (Part G, kept on purpose).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/Icon/Cl.reason: The icon box is twice --desktop-icon-size, which the size prop sets per icon; the root's --desktop-icon-cell would not follow it (Part G, kept on purpose).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/Slider/.reason: Thumb-on-track centering: the thumb's margin-top is half the difference of the track and thumb heights (($track-h - $thumb-h) / 2), so the thumb's center sits on the track's center line; geometry, not a role (H-R21).

Thumb-centering halves: the tick rail, tick labels and ghost thumb are inset by half the thumb's own size (#{$thumb-w} / 2, #{$thumb-h} / 2), so a value lands under the thumb's center; geometry, not a role (H-R21).

src/SystemFolder/SystemResources/Window/.reason: The utility window's local arrow unit, a quarter of its own local --window-scrollbar-size, as the theme's --window-scrollbar-arrow-size is of the root's (Part G, kept on purpose).
